text: {Name}, a survey assistant from {Place}, accepted a bribe to falsify a boundary, costing a family their home. The evicted family knew who had signed the false survey.
self_review: A survey assistant took a bribe to falsify a boundary and a family lost their home knowing who signed the false survey.
source_pattern: Plausible invention; the supplied research does not document fraudulent land surveying.
fictional_changes: The occupation, bribe, boundary fraud, and continuing relationship with its victims are entirely fictional.
